newsitem.title: USA: Fieldcrest Cannon extends credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Fieldcrest Cannon extends credit pact.

text.p: Fieldcrest Cannon Inc said Friday it entered into a new $200 million revolving credit agreement which matures on January 30, 2002, replacing its $195 million revolving credit agreement which would have matured on January 3, 1998.
The new agreement provides for a significant capital spending program of $70 million per year in 1997 and 1998 and $60 million per year in 1999 through 2001, the company said.
"Despite some improvements in our fourth-quarter performance, financial results for the year have been short of our expectations," chief executive James M. Fitzgibbons said.
The company earned $2.3 million in the latest quarter, resulting in a profit before restructuring charges of $6.1 million for all of 1996.

"We nevertheless are on course with our plan to reduce costs, make capital improvements and restructure this organization to leverage our strengths. This ongoing effort is better positioning Fieldcrest Cannon for the future," Fitzgibbons said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
